evidence.topic: MANIFEST.json current and historical append-only check
evidence.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
manifest=json.load(open('MANIFEST.json'))
print('manifest_rounds',len(manifest['rounds']))
print('manifest_last10',[(e.get('round'),e.get('type')) for e in manifest['rounds'][-10:]])
commits=subprocess.check_output(['git','log','-10','--format=%H','--','MANIFEST.json'],text=True).splitlines()
added=removed=0
for c in commits:
    diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','--format=','--unified=0',c,'--','MANIFEST.json'],text=True).splitlines()
    added+=sum(x.startswith('+') and not x.startswith('+++') and '"round"' in x for x in diff)
    removed+=sum(x.startswith('-') and not x.startswith('---') and '"round"' in x for x in diff)
print('last10_manifest_changes_added_round_lines/removed_round_lines',added,removed)
all_commits=subprocess.check_output(['git','log','--format=%H','--','MANIFEST.json'],text=True).splitlines()
removed_commits=[]; removed_lines=0
for c in all_commits:
    diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','--format=','--unified=0',c,'--','MANIFEST.json'],text=True).splitlines()
    n=sum(x.startswith('-') and not x.startswith('---') and '"round"' in x for x in diff)
    if n:
        removed_commits.append((c,n)); removed_lines+=n
print('all_history_removed_round_lines/commits',removed_lines,len(removed_commits))
for rev in ('e183bc170023^','e183bc170023'):
    data=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{rev}:MANIFEST.json'],text=True))
    print(rev,'length',len(data['rounds']),'round1_lanes',json.dumps(data['rounds'][1].get('lanes'),sort_keys=True))
PY
